$provenance: Provenance: written for circsim from CD4000-series (B-family) datasheet pinouts and typical propagation delays, MIT. These are XSPICE behavioral templates (adc_bridge -> ngspice digital primitive(s) -> dac_bridge), same expansion scheme as logic74hc.json. No third-party proprietary CD4000 model text is copied; only datasheet pinouts and datasheet-typical propagation delays inform the templates. IMPORTANT SWING CAVEAT: real CD4000 parts run from a 3-18 V rail; vHighDefault models a 12 V swing (chosen for the ~12-16.8 V battery rails these chips ride on real boards), the same scheme as the 74HC family's 5 V default. Since M10, deck generation derives vHigh from the DC bench supply DIRECTLY attached to the part's VDD pad net instead (only when exactly one supply sits on that net and the VSS pad is on the ground net — no tracing through components); every undeterminable case keeps this fixed 12 V swing default. Input thresholds are FRACTIONS of the same vHigh and scale with it: standard gates 30%/70% (3.6/8.4 V at the 12 V default) via adc_bridge/dac_bridge, Schmitt triggers 40%/60% (V_T-=4.8 V / V_T+=7.2 V band at the 12 V default). Schmitt-trigger templates do NOT use the adc_bridge path: each gate expands to a self-referential behavioral B-source whose flip state is held in the OUTPUT node voltage, giving TRUE hysteresis (state retention) rather than an undefined in-band level. While the output is HIGH the input must rise past V_T+ to flip it LOW; while LOW the input must fall past V_T- to flip it HIGH. Validated against real ngspice-46: an RC Schmitt astable self-oscillates rail-to-rail with the analytic period, and a static input holds the previous rail anywhere inside the V_T-..V_T+ band.

$schema.description: Each template expands to: one adc_bridge per logic-input pin, the listed digital primitive instances wired on internal d_* nodes, and one dac_bridge per logic-output pin. ADC/DAC thresholds and rails come from the chosen logic family rail (vHigh). Pin roles are by package-independent SIGNAL name; pinMaps translate package pad numbers to signal names.
$schema.gate.in: array of signal names feeding this gate's input(s)
$schema.gate.out: signal name produced (also a chip output pin if listed in outputs)
$schema.delaysNs: rise_delay/fall_delay applied to every gate (datasheet-typical tpd at VDD~10-15 V)

CD40106.desc: Hex inverting Schmitt trigger. Each gate expands to a self-referential behavioral B-source with TRUE hysteresis: switching thresholds at 40%/60% of vHigh (V_T-=4.8 V / V_T+=7.2 V at the default 12 V rail) — full-high output below V_T-, full-low above V_T+, and inside the band the output HOLDS its previous rail (state retention), so RC Schmitt astables self-oscillate. Pin-compatible with the 74HC14.

CD4011.desc: Quad 2-input NAND. NOTE: the CD4011 pinout is NOT the 74HC00 pinout — outputs are on pins 3, 4, 10, 11.
